cap.locator: Table 4, PDF p19: Central Arizona Water Conservation District, pumped from Lake Havasu (project 904,678 + non-project 2,033 AF); measured and unmeasured returns 0

why: Las Vegas treats its wastewater and sends it down Las Vegas Wash back into Lake Mead, where it is credited and can be pumped again. Water carried by the CAP canal to central and southern Arizona cannot flow back to the Colorado River, so none of it is credited as a return.
